what_is_compared: the same points (copied out of the Qdrant index), query embeddings, RRF fusion and cross-encoder on each backend; only where the dense and BM25 candidate lists come from changes

dense.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

qdrant.role: reference: the project's Retriever (rag/retriever.py); RRF fusion inside Qdrant
qdrant.dense_leg: qdrant (exact search in local embedded mode)

memory.role: control: exact brute-force search in Python with the same fusion code as pinecone/weaviate
memory.bm25_leg: in-memory exact IDF-weighted dot product (Qdrant's IDF formula)

pinecone.transport: data plane: SDK gRPC client; control plane: REST API version 2025-01
pinecone.bm25_leg: pinecone sparse index; query weights multiplied by Qdrant's IDF before the query

weaviate.vector_index: HNSW, cosine distance, self-provided vectors (no vectorizer module), default HNSW settings
weaviate.bm25_leg: app-side: in-memory exact BM25 over the same sparse vectors (Weaviate cannot store them)

native_modes_settings.weaviate_bm25: Weaviate BM25 over embedding_text (word tokenization, no stemming, k1=1.2, b=0.75)
native_modes_settings.weaviate_hybrid: Weaviate hybrid, rankedFusion, alpha=0.5, our query vector
